app_tagline: [कोंकणी] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [कोंकणी] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [कोंकणी] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [कोंकणी] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [कोंकणी] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [कोंकणी] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [कोंकणी] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [कोंकणी] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [कोंकणी] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [कोंकणी] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [कोंकणी] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [कोंकणी] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [कोंकणी] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [कोंकणी] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [कोंकणी] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [कोंकणी] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [कोंकणी] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [कोंकणी] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [कोंकणी] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [कोंकणी] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [कोंकणी] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [कोंकणी] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [कोंकणी] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [कोंकणी] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [कोंकणी] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [कोंकणी] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [कोंकणी] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [कोंकणी] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [कोंकणी] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [kok] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [kok] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [kok] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [kok] Type or speak your question for the helper...
